items.summary: The pursuit of fair and equitable AI in human-centric tasks is critically hindered by the inherent biases and privacy risks of real-world datasets, which offer imbalanced representations of identity and often contain sensitive personal information. Consequently, state-of-the-art generative models trained on this skewed data exhibit unfair performance, particularly in identity-preserving generation. In this work we propose a pipeline for controllable generation of dataset with diverse faces for generative models training and finetuning. items.title: Decoupled Predictive Decision Making: A Shared Conditional Predictor for Agents
items.summary: Agent decisions depend on empirical relationships that deployment observations reveal and task descriptions alone may leave unresolved. We introduce Decoupled Predictive Decision Making (DPDM), an architecture that formulates heterogeneous agent decisions as conditional prediction with a shared pretrained learner. Language models provide semantic representations of current and historical records, while a general-purpose conditional predictor predicts task-defined targets from the represented evidence. items.title: SAE Interprets MoE: Sparse AutoEncoders Reveal That MoE Experts Exhibit Human-Interpretable Fine-Grained Specialization
items.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a few of many experts, yet what an individual expert is responsible for remains unsettled. Existing analyses count how often an expert is selected on domain-labeled corpora, an instrument that fixes the taxonomy in advance, stays coarse, and records selection rather than contribution. We instead study specialization in feature space by training a sparse autoencoder (SAE) on the output of an MoE layer. items.title: HeLM: Hierarchical Explicit Language Memory for Non-Markovian Manipulation
items.summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have enabled fine manipulation capabilities, yet performing tasks that require working memory remains a key challenge. Most existing VLA architectures operate under a Markovian assumption, mapping only the current observation to an action, which leads to failure in non-Markovian environments. Inspired by the human 'inner monologue', we propose Hierarchical Explicit Language Memory (HeLM), a hierarchical VLA framework that maintains task-relevant history in explicit language through factorized event detection and event-triggered memory upda…

items.title: TailSteer: Trajectory-Tail Steering for Drift-Resistant Multi-turn Image Editing
items.summary: Strong single-turn editing performance does not guarantee reliable multi-turn interaction: as edited outputs are repeatedly reused, small unintended changes can accumulate into severe visual drift. This long-term drift is often mitigated through training on multi-turn data or cross-turn rollouts, potentially altering pretrained priors, or through specialized inference-time mechanisms that are difficult to scale to foundation models. items.summary: For a decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been measured by how much a machine can do on its own. Large foundation models now write code and run multistep tasks, and personal agents act on a person's behalf. items.title: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
items.summary: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to provide continuous personalized assistance by retaining user information across interactions. Existing systems support this process through fact extraction, organization, updating, and retrieval, but largely maintain memories as independent facts. This fact-centric paradigm may overlook how new facts update, constrain, or conflict with earlier ones, while leaving their applicability, role, and priority for the current request implicit. items.summary: Chunk-interleaved full-duplex speech language models listen and speak in fixed time chunks, and each chunk must be processed before the next one arrives. Their workload is asymmetric across chunks: listen chunks leave compute idle while awaiting audio, and speak and tool-call chunks require serial generation, which delays responses and tool calls. items.summary: Reliable robotic manipulation requires both semantic understanding and precise control in three-dimensional space. However, vision-language-action (VLA) foundations largely inherit visual representations from 2D vision-language pre-training, while spatial supervision is often introduced only during task-specific adaptation. items.summary: World Action Models (WAMs) use the predictive knowledge of pretrained video diffusion models for robot control through future video prediction. However, iterative video denoising is costly, and inaccurate visual predictions can compromise action prediction. Our key idea is to make this predictive knowledge available through visual representations computed from the current observation, enabling action prediction without generating future videos. items.summary: Jailbreak benchmarks test one checkpoint and treat which jailbreaks break it as a property of its pretraining data and safety training. items.summary: Harness evolution from a common base exhibits Locality, Complementarity, and Nonstationarity: variants repair different failures, and their utility changes as the policy learns. items.summary: Multimodal agents use web and image tools to answer questions beyond their internal knowledge. Some search tasks use images mainly to identify an initial entity, then rely on text retrieval. These tasks offer limited insight into how agents connect information across images, objects, and search steps. We therefore focus on visual context management. items.summary: We present WeLM-Image, a unified image foundation model that integrates multimodal understanding into text-to-image generation, instruction-guided editing, and multi-reference synthesis. items.summary: Egocentric human video offers a scalable source of manipulation priors for robot learning, yet translating raw data scale into generalizable robot policies demands rigorous data curation and training recipes. items.summary: Current medical benchmarks typically break down clinical competence into isolated factual questions, single-image tasks, or static case vignettes. These tests score individual answers, but reveal less about whether a model can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and track a patient's condition throughout a course of care. items.summary: Recent advances in Gaussian splatting have enabled efficient and photorealistic head avatar reconstruction, yet monocular video-based or image-based methods still suffer from under-constrained geometry and texture, leading to artifacts such as blurring, stretching, and temporal instability. We present EDGAR (Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement), a conditional diffusion framework designed to enhance the quality of Gaussian avatars by correcting artifacts while preserving identity fidelity. items.title: Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand
items.summary: Benchmark compression reduces the often prohibitive time and cost of model evaluation by evaluating models on a small benchmark subset that closely matches full-benchmark results. items.title: Towards Foundation Decision Models: Drex
items.summary: Autoregressive approaches with large language models, such as long chain-of-thought reasoning, have become the default for new AI applications because they reach higher accuracy on a wide range of tasks. In production, however, they give inconsistent answers, require parsing of outputs, and add cost and latency. Decision models address this: given a question and a set of options supplied by the user, they return a probability distribution over the options without autoregressive decoding. items.title: D3D: Decoupled Diffusion Drafting for Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
items.summary: Target-conditioned diffusion drafters predict candidate tokens in parallel, yet each new block must wait for updated target-model hidden states. This forces drafting and verification to run sequentially, limiting speedup even though each block is generated in one pass. We introduce D3D, a standalone diffusion drafter that removes this inter-round dependency. items.summary: Sparse attention cuts the cost of long-context inference by making the attention matrix sparse: each query attends only a subset of the sequence, chosen by a fixed pattern or, in recent production LLMs, learned per query. items.summary: A frontier AI model is trained in an AI data center, on tens of thousands of accelerators joined by a dedicated network, and every training step ends with all of them exchanging data at once. items.title: TaoMate-HD: Progressive-Resolution Autoregressive Audio-Video Generation
items.summary: Streaming digital humans produce detailed video while continuing speech as new text arrives. High-resolution denoising is costly, and text updates can cause repeated or interrupted speech. We present TaoMate-HD, an autoregressive model for high-resolution audio-video streaming. items.title: User Embeddings are Superpositions of Interpretable Behavioral Modes
items.summary: User embeddings are central components of modern recommendation, personalization, and behavioral modeling systems. Though these embeddings can compactly encode rich behavioral information, they are inherently dense and opaque, limiting interpretability. items.summary: Scientific figures give research ideas a visual form through choices of abstraction, composition, and emphasis. items.summary: Grounded reasoning, where a model outputs text coordinates of relevant locations in chain-of-thought reasoning, is a common strategy for solving complex visual reasoning problems. items.summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. items.summary: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. items.summary: Modern video models possess strong visual priors, yet do not natively represent human action in metric 3D space. items.summary: ML code should run where researchers choose, not where it was first written. Today, machine learning code mainly lives in two ecosystems, PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs and JAX on Google TPUs. items.summary: To interpret a direction in a language model's residual stream, we can look for text that strongly activates it. items.title: 办了33年的ACM MM，重新划定研究范围
items.summary: 随着AI的发展，多媒体的研究边界在进一步拓宽。 作者丨张 驰 编辑丨马晓宁 今年11月10日，国际多媒体领域顶级学术会议 ACM Multimedia（ACM MM）将在巴西里约热内卢举行。届时雷峰网也前往大会现场，带来第一手的报道。 欢迎扫描文末二维码入群与我们交流。 与往年相比，这届会议有一个容易重大的变化，征稿主题被重新划分了。 在去年底，ACM MM学术指导委员会投票通过新的研究主题体系。过去的 五大主题、15个子方向，改为16个平级研究主题 。 看上去只是调整分类，但对照新旧名单看的话，可以发现部分研究被放到了更醒目的位置。对比之后，我们发现了几个显著的变化。 01 新增具身智能与多模态推理 最值得注意的是两个新增的独立主题： 具身与沉浸式多媒体 （Embodied and Immersive Multimedia）和 多媒体推理 （Multimedia Reasoning）。 前者的官方定义，特别提到能够在真实世界感知、行动和交互的智能体，以及视觉、语言、音频和触觉等多种信息的整合。 不过这也不是说，ACM MM 在转型成机器人会议，它强调的是具身智能中的多媒体、多模态研究，不是机器人硬件、控制、运动规划问题。 传统的多媒体研究主要处理图像、声音、视频等内容，具身系统需要将多模态感知与行动联系起来。 多媒体推理 则强调对图像、视频、语音和文本，进行逻辑、因果、时间与空间…

items.title: CoRL 六年：论文数×4.5，谁在推着它涨？

items.summary: 众所不周知，微信输入法存在一个内置的敏感词库 具体表现为：命中该词库的输入，无法组词、联想、形成记忆、永远不会出现在候选中（例如：鸡巴） 该词库并非实时联网获取，而是直接集成在输入法的安装包内 出于兴趣，在 AI 的辅助下，我编写了本微信输入法敏感词提取器 目前该词库的词条数量在 1 万出头，提取效果预览： ~~（由于内容过于劲爆，这里不放结果了）~~ 本工具从微信输入法安装目录的.\BuildIn\cell_dict.ssrc.zh 文件提取，在 Windows 最新版测试通过 具体用法： ``` python export_sensitive_single.py -f -o ``` 此外还有一些有趣的发现，微信输入法还另内置一个不那么敏感的“敏感词”库（ kind=440 ） 该额外的词库虽然可以组词，但是在输入法实现中被单独归类， 至于是否有特殊处理（比如记录），本人没有进一步分析 工具下载地址： https://pastebin.com/emEXbrCh （提取码：x7E56zQ4uZ ）

items.title: 做了一款 iOS 阅读器「随阅」，目前限免，欢迎试试
items.summary: 最近做了一款阅读器 App ，叫「随阅 NoriReader 」，可以把在线阅读书源和本地书库放在一起 ![]( https://i.imgur.com/fwGihKQ.png) 目前主要有这些功能： - **在线书源**：支持 Legado 格式的 JSON 书源，在 App 内搜索和阅读。 - **本地书库**：支持导入文件、整个目录，阅读 TXT 、EPUB 、MOBI 、AZW3 等格式的电子书。 - **小说和漫画**：小说支持分页、卷页和滑动翻页；漫画支持在线阅读，也可以导入 CBZ 、图片 ZIP 。 - **阅读设置**：字体、字号、背景、行距、目录、书签、标注、阅读进度这些都有，基本借鉴（抄的） Books 。 - **书架和历史**：可以收藏书籍，也能直接从历史记录继续读。 目前限免，现有功能大家可以先免费用着。觉得好用的话，也可以通过 App 内的随阅 Max 支持一下，哈哈。 下个版本准备把 Max 的高级权益划分清楚，具体怎么分还在琢磨。目前也还没研究明白兑换码怎么弄，等我搞定了，会回来抽 **20 个移动端 Max 、10 个全端 Max**。感兴趣、觉得好用的朋友可以留个邮箱，到时候回来更新抽奖。 平台方面，目前只有 iOS 版，主要按 iPhone 的体验来做，iPad 还没专门优化。后面计划继续做 iPad 、Mac 和 Vision 端。至于 A…
